l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: land of Moroni is a land (bordering the seashore)
q: the Lamanites had come into the land of Moroni, which was in the borders by the seashore.

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: city of Moroni is a city (in the land of Moroni)
q: And it came to pass that the Nephites were not sufficiently strong in the city of Moroni;

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: city of Moroni has fortifications (captured by Amalickiah)
q: And it came to pass that Amalickiah took possession of the city, yea, possession of all their fortifications.

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: city of Nephihah is a city (receiving refugees from Moroni)
q: And those who fled out of the city of Moroni came to the city of Nephihah;

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: Pahoran refuses to alter law (despite petitions)
q: But behold, Pahoran would not alter nor suffer the law to be altered;

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: land Bountiful has tents pitched in the borders of the land Bountiful
q: And it came to pass that Teancum and his men did pitch their tents in the borders of the land Bountiful;

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: contention over the law is settled by the voice of the people
q: And it came to pass that this matter of their contention was settled by the voice of the people.

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: settlement by the voice of the people favors freemen (allowing Pahoran to retain the judgment-seat)
q: And it came to pass that the voice of the people came in favor of the freemen, and Pahoran retained the judgment-seat,

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: Lamanite invasion is prepared for war against the people of the Nephites
q: for behold, Amalickiah had again stirred up the hearts of the people of the Lamanites against the people of the Nephites, and he was gathering together soldiers from all parts of his land, and arming them, and preparing for war with all diligence;

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: war against the Nephites is prepared for by Amalickiah (with a large army)
q: But behold, we shall see that his promise which he made was rash; nevertheless, he did prepare himself and his armies to come to battle against the Nephites.

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: capture of Nephite cities takes possession of many cities
q: And thus he went on, taking possession of many cities, the city of Nephihah, and the city of Lehi, and the city of Morianton, and the city of Omner, and the city of Gid, and the city of Mulek,

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: death of Amalickiah is caused by Teancum (with a javelin)
q: And it came to pass that Teancum stole privily into the tent of the king, and put a javelin to his heart; and he did cause the death of the king immediately

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: Amalickiah is a king (of the Lamanites)
q: Teancum stole privily into the tent of the king,

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: title of liberty is hoisted by king-men (after submitting to the cause of freedom)
q: and were compelled to hoist the title of liberty upon their towers, and in their cities, and to take up arms in defence of their country.

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: Amalickiah leads Lamanite army (against the Nephites)
q: Yea, even Amalickiah did himself come down, at the head of the Lamanites.

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: Amalickiah swears to drink the blood of Moroni
q: for he had sworn to drink the blood of Moroni.

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: Amalickiah possesses city of Moroni (after driving out the Nephites)
q: And it came to pass that the Nephites were not sufficiently strong in the city of Moroni; therefore Amalickiah did drive them, slaying many. And it came to pass that Amalickiah took possession of the city, yea, possession of all their fortifications.

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: Amalickiah causes capture of Nephite cities (by cunning and numberless hosts)
q: And thus had the Lamanites obtained, by the cunning of Amalickiah, so many cities, by their numberless hosts,

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: Moroni sees Lamanites (coming into the borders of the land)
q: when Moroni saw this, and also saw that the Lamanites were coming into the borders of the land, he was exceedingly wroth

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: Amalickiah is dead in his own tent
q: they found Amalickiah was dead in his own tent

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: Teancum takes a small number of men (and march down near the seashore)
q: Teancum should take a small number of men and march down near the seashore

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: Moroni commands armies
q: Moroni commanded his men that they should fall upon them until they had given up their weapons of war.

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: Moroni maintains war preparations (for the Nephite lands)
q: Moroni—who had established armies to protect the south and the west borders of the land

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: Moroni has wounded state wounded (in battle)
q: and there were many slain on both sides; yea, and Moroni was wounded and Jacob was killed.

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: Jacob is a Zoramite
q: Jacob, who was a Zoramite

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: Jacob leads Lamanites (at the city of Mulek)
q: their leader, whose name was Jacob

l: The Book of Alma, the Son of Alma
s: Jacob has spirit unconquerable spirit
q: Jacob, being their leader, being also a Zoramite, and having an unconquerable spirit
